Board minutes describe the FY2025 payment as the third annual settlement in an ongoing series of commercial disputes with former channel partners and note the Board asked whether provision should be made for a further settlement in FY2026. That recurrence directly conflicts with non-recurring treatment.

adjustments.description: Pro-forma full-year effect of new logos
adjustments.management_rationale: Annualising the FY2025 in-year contribution of logos won during the year.
adjustments.reasoning: This is a pro-forma annualization rather than FY2025 realized EBITDA. Underlying revenue data shows Cascade Foods Holdings started invoicing in June 2025 and generated 1.206m in 2025, while legacy Cascade Foods generated 407k in January 2025 under an expired prior contract. The supplied evidence supports that a new/re-engaged customer relationship existed in FY2025, but not that a 1.65m EBITDA add-back is appropriate. The Cascade agreement itself states this was a re-engagement after lapse of a prior agreement, which weakens the characterization as a pure new-logo uplift.

amount.finding: No margin build, cost assumption set, or EBITDA conversion support for 1.65m was provided.

period.finding: Annualized full-year effect extends beyond FY2025 realized performance.

recurrence.finding: No direct historical pro-forma new-logo adjustment found in available structured history.

duplication.finding: No duplicate FY2025 pro-forma new-logo row found.

underlying_data.finding: Customer and ARR data show re-engagement after lapse, partial-year revenue, and no support for EBITDA annualization amount.

document_support.finding: Cascade contract recitals describe re-engagement after prior agreement expiry rather than a clean new-logo win.

sql_evidence.purpose: Validate top customer revenue and assess customer support around new-logo claims and other inconsistencies
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT YEAR(fi.invoice_date) AS calendar_year, c.customer_name, dc.contract_id, ROUND(SUM(fi.invoice_amount_usd),2) AS revenue_usd, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.fact_invoice fi JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_customer c ON fi.customer_id = c.customer_id LEFT JOIN workspace.aava_deal_studio.dim_contract dc ON fi.contract_id = dc.contract_id WHERE YEAR(fi.invoice_date)=2025 GROUP BY YEAR(fi.invoice_date), c.customer_name, dc.contract_id ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC LIMIT 20
sql_evidence.result_summary: Top FY2025 customers include Northwind 11.72m, Vantage 5.26m, Pinnacle 5.01m, Atlas 2.03m, Meridian 1.78m, Brightpath 1.27m, Cascade Foods Holdings 1.21m, and Cascade Foods 0.41m.

sql_evidence.purpose: Apply challenged verdict mapping and accepted amounts to FY2025 adjustments
sql_evidence.sql_query: SELECT adjustment_id, fiscal_year, category, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd, CASE WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE '%legal settlement%' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-005' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-010' THEN 'Rejected' WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-006','ADJ-009') THEN 'Accepted' WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-004','ADJ-007') THEN 'Challenged' ELSE 'Rejected' END AS verdict, CASE WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE '%legal settlement%' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-005' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-010' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-006','ADJ-009') THEN CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-004' THEN 625000.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-007' THEN 0.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS accepted_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025' ORDER BY adjustment_id
sql_evidence.result_summary: Verdicts assigned to all 7 FY2025 adjustments; accepted amounts total 1,805,000.00 across ADJ-004 (625,000), ADJ-006 (870,000), and ADJ-009 (310,000).

sql_evidence.sql_query: WITH classified AS (SELECT adjustment_id, CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) AS amount_usd, CASE WHEN LOWER(category) LIKE '%legal settlement%' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-005' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-010' THEN 0.0 WHEN adjustment_id IN ('ADJ-006','ADJ-009') THEN CAST(amount_usd AS DOUBLE) WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-004' THEN 625000.0 WHEN adjustment_id = 'ADJ-007' THEN 0.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS accepted_amount_usd FROM workspace.aava_deal_studio.mgmt_ebitda_adjustment WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025') SELECT ROUND(SUM(amount_usd),2) AS management_adjustments_total_usd, ROUND(SUM(accepted_amount_usd),2) AS accepted_adjustments_total_usd, ROUND(SUM(amount_usd - accepted_amount_usd),2) AS challenged_or_rejected_adjustments_total_usd, ROUND(4280000 + SUM(accepted_amount_usd),2) AS team_adjusted_ebitda_usd, ROUND((4280000 + SUM(amount_usd)) - (4280000 + SUM(accepted_amount_usd)),2) AS earnings_challenge_usd FROM classified
sql_evidence.result_summary: Management adjustments 8,120,000.00; accepted adjustments 1,805,000.00; challenged/rejected 6,315,000.00; Team Adjusted EBITDA 6,085,000.00; earnings challenge 6,315,000.00.
